title: Paused-queue card: the 'other' cause line can show a stale preview (last assistant excerpt) as the reason for the pause
outcome: The paused-queue card never presents a preview that is not a pause cause (a last-message excerpt, 'Waiting for activity.') as the reason the queue is paused: it labels the line neutrally or shows it only for known pause causes.
acceptance: Paused-queue card: the 'other' cause line can show a stale preview (last assistant excerpt) as the reason for the pause is done
